report_identity.report_title: Singamas Container Holdings Limited Annual Report 2023

business_overview.one_sentence: The group manufactures and leases containers and provides container depot and logistics services mainly in the PRC.

segments.business_substance: Manufacturing dry freight, tank, flatrack, offshore and specialised containers, container parts, and leasing dry freight containers.
segments.source: Annual Report 2023, note 6 segment revenue and results, p.174

segments.business_substance: Container storage, handling, repair, drayage, freight station and related depot services.
segments.source: Annual Report 2023, note 6 segment revenue and results, p.174

business_overview.revenue_model: Manufacturing revenue is recognized when container control transfers after inspection/acceptance and delivery where applicable; logistics services are billed generally monthly with 30-60 day credit terms.
business_notes: The group has five PRC factories and eight PRC container depots according to the corporate profile.
Manufacturing and leasing contributed most 2023 revenue; logistics services contributed a smaller but steadier revenue base.
